levels.3: Complete the full fifteen-wave session and remain through the result screen. Use mines on vehicle approaches and keep an exit route from each hold point; quitting early does not register the map clear.

levels.2: Clear all 15 waves on Hellfire and Beachhead in cooperative Survival.
levels.3: Complete both maps in private co-op from wave one through wave fifteen. Revive a downed partner before both players fall, share ammunition between rounds, and remain until each results screen appears.

levels.2: Finish Radio Silence once as Sniper and once as Operative.
levels.3: Choose roles before launch. As Operative, tag targets and complete ground interactions; as Sniper, clear distant threats and protect the route. Swap roles and finish the full mission again so both role records are complete.

levels.2: Finish Tiger Hunt once as Sniper and once as Operative.
levels.3: Complete the mission with the Operative handling ground objectives and the Sniper controlling long sightlines, then exchange roles and replay. Both full extractions are required for a complete role set.

levels.2: With the free or Ultimate content installed, finish Twilight Strike once as Sniper and once as Operative.
levels.3: Select Twilight Strike from Challenges, complete every shared objective and extract, then swap roles. During cleanup, also take the extreme-distance shot from the Sniper route and clear every optional marker shown by the mission panel.
